Vevo, measured

Every colour, size and radius on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json, read on the public marketing site at hq.vevo.com on 2026-11-21. The site paints a black-and-white shell, a crimson stats band, and page grounds that change by section. There is no dark theme, so there is no theme toggle. The drawings below are rebuilt from the tokens. The real pixels are in screenshots/ and components/crops/.

The loaded face is a Wix-hosted cut. Its public name was not captured, so this page uses Helvetica. Pink and lilac page grounds were seen and not read as computed colours, so they are not tokens. Motion durations measured 0s and are not drawn.

Colour

Black and white carry the shell. Crimson rgb(161, 0, 46) is the stats band and the empty-field border. Slate rgb(112, 115, 129) is the advertiser form ground. Purple rgb(149, 7, 255) marks the current item in the phone drawer.

Typography

Measured weights are 400. Nav is 14/21, pills 16/22.4, submit 18/25.2, fields 15px, the phone drawer 22px, and the stats figure 74.5px. The homepage headline is fluid and is not a token.

Family

font.family.sansHelvetica fallback. Public face name not captured.
Music videos. Originals. Artists.

Shape and sizes

Pills use a 24px radius. Submit uses 999px. Fields stay square. The header reads 77px, buttons 46px, fields 41px, the textarea 104px, and the native checkbox 13px.
